{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Exclude patients with sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
valid_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0
df_valid = df[valid_mask]

# Check the new distribution of arms
print("New arm distribution after excluding sentinel values:")
print(df_valid['arm'].value_counts())

# Check if the response rate is comparable across arms in the valid subset
print(f"\nResponse rate in control arm: {df_valid[df_valid['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean():.3f}")
print(f"\nResponse rate in treatment arm: {df_valid[df_valid['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean():.3f}")

# Compute the treatment effect as difference in proportions
control_response_rate = df_valid[df_valid['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()
treatment_response_rate = df_valid[df_valid['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

print(f"\nTreatment effect (treatment minus control): {treatment_effect:.3f}")

# Return the final values
control_response_rate, treatment_response_rate, treatment_effect"}
